extracted.name: Spinach Salad with Poppy Seed Dressing
extracted.description: Spinach salad with poppy seed dressing is a colorful mix of baby greens, mandarin oranges, and almonds, topped with a sweet and tangy favorite.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 cup creamy salad dressing (e.g. Miracle Whip®)
instruction_lines: Make poppy seed dressing: Whisk together creamy salad dressing, vinegar, sugar, and poppy seeds; set aside.
Prepare the salad: Arrange spinach leaves, mixed salad greens, oranges, onion, then almonds onto individual salad plates.
Drizzle with poppy seed dressing to serve.
